name: openslack
description: OpenSlack — local-first, Git-backed operating system for AI agents

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build && bun run schema:stage && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/release/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/public-pack/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/live-capstone/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/qualification-capstone/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/contract-delivery-rehearsal/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/organization-graph-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/governance-control-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-control-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-authority-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-control-shadow-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-checkpoint-shadow-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-effect-control-contracts/tsconfig.json && bun run workflow:effect-control-golden -- --check && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workflow-runner-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/qualification/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/notification-qualification/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/notification-docs/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/documentation/tsconfig.json
scripts.graph:dist-build: bunx tsc --build packages/organization-graph/tsconfig.json --clean && bunx tsc --build packages/organization-graph/tsconfig.json --force && bun run schema:stage
scripts.public:pack: bun run build && bun scripts/public-pack/index.ts pack
scripts.public:verify: bun run build && bun scripts/public-pack/index.ts verify
